fishing: WHEN: Fri Oct 16, prefer moving water dawn/dusk (best early light), recent wind/king tides/rain made it tough; back bays more reliable. PASSES-BEACH: Fishin Franks limited/no fresh reports (weather); limited beach action. LEMON BAY: redfish & flounder on live shrimp & gold spoons (Capt Roger Oct 13); mangrove snapper, small snook around docks/Chadwick pier, trout on flats (Fishin Franks Oct 9). NEARSHORE: weather-limited; mangrove snapper, possible migrating cobia. Baits: live shrimp, gold spoons, soft plastics, pilchards, cut bait.
redtide: FWC Oct 16: K. brevis at background concentrations in 6 samples from and offshore of Southwest Florida (incl. in/offshore Sarasota). No fish kills or respiratory irritation reported over the past week.
bacteria: Englewood Beach GOOD ~20 CFU/100mL (DOH Charlotte Healthy Beaches, latest sample). No advisory. Palm Island also GOOD.
fpl: Charlotte 3 customers out; Sarasota 25 out (FPL Power Tracker ~4:57 PM ET). No major Englewood spike.
